rows.notes: The study is labelled 'Review' and compiles published UAV studies (Table 1) comparing remote indices with ground-truth plant data; it reports no own experiment, survey or model runs. The correlations of UAV indices with water potential and stomatal conductance (e.g. CWSI vs gs R2=0.91 in olives, Baluja et al. 2012 TCARI/OSAVI vs gs R2=0.84) are results from other works. No own result on improved irrigation efficiency, pumping costs or water conservation; at most it discusses the potential of UAV indices for water stress detection, a precondition of the claimed effect.

Review article with no primary data. It compiles others' results on UAV reflectance and thermal indices correlating with plant water status indicators. Groundwater retention or recharge is not mentioned anywhere in the study; the review only addresses the upstream step of detecting crop water stress from UAV imagery.

notes: The cited document is a narrative review (Agricultural Water Management 153:9-19, explicitly headed 'Review') summarising UAV remote sensing studies for water stress assessment; Table 1 compiles R2 values from other authors.
